text:
sophia: heads-up: during the SDK v3 canary we saw a surge of duplicate session_ids and WS early-close traces. console shows session_count doubling briefly and quota metering spiking. anyone digging in?
maria: saw quota alerts for customer-facing routes. looks like client reconnect loop, but the WS server logs show `pong` latency ok. weird.
aj: initial look: new client sends a rapid sequence of `upgrade` attempts when it hits a 1s socket idle timer. the server had a recent change that lowers keepalive grace to 800ms for certain proxies. timing mismatch maybe.
kevin: if proxies are closing at 800ms but client retries at 1s we get overlapping half-open sessions. our billing path counts new session start before detecting duplicate -> double-charging window.
sre-bot: alert: route=stream-public region=us observed session-start-rate > 400/s (expected < 50/s). auto-scaling triggered.
tyler: telemetry-wise the dashboard aggregates `session_start` and `session_end` by minute; a short flurry of overlapping starts without immediate ends looks like leakage. console p50 stays fine but p99 of `connect_time` jumps.
dave: i reproduced locally by running 10 clients with jitter disabled. flipping `--no-jitter` triggers the same spike. adding jitter fixes it.
sophia: so we have two issues: timing mismatch causing synchronized reconnect storms, and console/dashboard doesn't show the overlap metric (start vs active) clearly. ops can't quickly tell if starts are overlapping vs long-lived connections.
maria: UX ask: add an "active_sessions" realtime gauge and a small chart showing concurrent starts vs concurrent active. also annotate when proxy grace timer was changed so rollout correlation is easier.
console-bot: created ticket #UI-879 "Add concurrent session gauge + rollout annotations" assigned to eng-platform.
aj: infra change required: align keepalive grace with client default. either extend proxy grace to 1.2s or change SDK to back off earlier. we should prefer client-side change to avoid widening proxy timeouts globally.
kevin: agree on client fix, but we need short-term guardrails: (1) debounce session-starts in billing pipe for 2s to avoid double charge, (2) add a header `X-Session-Attempt: <attempt-count>` so we can dedupe in metering.
tyler: putting dedupe in billing sounds risky but doable as a 2-week mitigation. console should also display `sample_rate` and `metering.dedupe_applied` flags in traces so we can verify.
dave: i'll open an SDK PR to add jitter + exponential reconnect backoff default, and emit `X-Client-Canary: sdk-v3-canary` header for easier filtering.
sophia: thanks. meanwhile i'll roll the canary back one step and hold. can we add a temporary route rule that prefers sticky routing (same backend) so reconnects don't hit new proxy variants? that should reduce half-open overlap.
kevin: temporary sticky rule applied to `stream-public` for the canary tag. also added billing debounce as a config override for that route.
(10:34) maria: after sticky rule + debounce the quota spikes stopped in the last 5m. active_sessions gauge would have made this faster to detect.
(10:36) tyler: follow-ups: AJ + Dave to land SDK jitter PR; Kevin to propose short-term billing dedupe plan and rollback criteria; Sophia and Maria to spec dashboard changes. we'll also decide whether sampling decision should be pre- or post-routing in the next eng-platform sync.
sophia: added notes to rollout playbook: explicitly test keepalive/grace timers and include client jitter in canary checks.
(10:45) aj: one more note 006: add trace header `X-Trace-Session` on all session start attempts. that should make tracing through routing->proxy->billing trivial.
sophia: good call. thanks everyone.
